articles.title: Why did a Russian military plane carrying its spy chief land in Israel?
articles.description: A US-sanctioned Russian military aircraft landed at Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport amid the Iran war, raising questions about Moscow’s ties with Tel Aviv and Tehran. The plane reportedly carried GRU chief Admiral Igor Kostyukov. Was the surprise visit linked to US-mediated Russia-Ukraine negotiations in Abu Dhabi?

articles.title: Trump to meet Iran war mediator Qatar, no imminent deal seen to end the war
articles.description: With no victory in sight more than eight months into the conflict he launched alongside Israel on February 28, Trump has played down the likelihood of major warfare restarting soon, but remains unwilling to accept an existing Iranian truce plan.

articles.title: Trump to meet Iran war mediator Qatar, no imminent deal seen to end the war
articles.description: CAIRO/ABU DHABI, Nov 9 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump will meet the prime minister of key mediator Qatar on Monday as efforts to end the Iran war ramp up following last week's midterm elections, though senior US and Gulf officials cast doubt on the chances of an imminent deal.With no victory in sight more than eight months into the conflict he launched alongside Israel on February 28, Trump has played down the likelihood of major warfare restarting soon, but remains unwilling to accept an existing Iranian truce plan.

articles.title: Iran's Abbas Araghchi Says No Peace Talks With US Since 'Shock' Of Midterms
articles.description: Various regional powers, including Qatar and Pakistan, have been trying for months without success to bring a definitive halt to the war launched by the United States and Israel in late February.

articles.title: Americans are "disgusted with Israel" and tired of its "forever wars": Iranian Foreign Minister
articles.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi criticised US ties with Israel on X, citing President Trump's comments on public war fatigue. Meanwhile, Trump stated that new military strikes against Iran are unlikely as negotiations and Treasury sanctions on cryptocurrency networks continue.
